_meta.title: Brief status register — S-04…S-25 and SG-27…SG-30
_meta.method: Each row has two columns that are never merged. 'Brief says' is copied from the brief. 'This repo shows' is what was measured or read in this checkout (branch arena/38650305-zone3). Rows marked 'Not found' have no matching text or file here, whatever the brief says. The brief's status labels cite the owner's Zone4 decision log (https://kanlerxz87-cyber.github.io/Zone4/docs/decisions.html); that log was reachable on 2026-11-17 but its individual S-rows were not re-read line by line, so 'Brief says' is not independently verified.

status_vocabulary.Verified here: Measured or read in this checkout on the date shown.
status_vocabulary.Partly here: Some of the claimed work is present; the rest is missing or not measured.
status_vocabulary.Not found here: The brief claims it, but no matching page or file exists in this checkout.
status_vocabulary.Conflict: The repo does something the brief rules out.
status_vocabulary.Blocked (owner): Needs an account, a decision or a host that this build cannot reach.
status_vocabulary.Not measured: No measurement was made this session.

_meta.remeasure_method: sessions/8aa259bb/measure_brief_rows.py (read-only). Rows that changed keep the 2026-11-17 text in 'prior_2026_11_17'. The 'brief_says' column is still quoted from the brief; the Zone4 decision rows were re-read on 2026-11-19 from a shallow clone of kanlerxz87-cyber/Zone4 (main) and checked against their recorded or open status.

rows.item: Give every page its own title and meta description
rows.this_repo_shows: Measured 2026-11-19 by sessions/8aa259bb/measure_brief_rows.py: all 120 published HTML pages (excluding archive/, docs/, sessions/) carry a non-empty <title> and a meta description. Two pages carry the generic description the publish pass added (flag M38-F-05; the 2026-11-17 figure of six is superseded). Whether the wording is right is a separate open question (Zone4 D-04, recorded option A: keep and review the wording).

prior_2026_11_17.this_repo_shows: All 104 published HTML pages (excluding archive/, docs/, sessions/) carry a <title> and a meta description. Measured 2026-11-17. Where a page had no description, the publish pass added a generic one built from the title (flag M38-F-05).

The 1,215 anchors to affiliate-program.amazon.com are policy and agreement citations, not product links, and carry no rel by design. The disclosure sentence appears on 120 of 120 pages. The 2026-11-17 figures (1,447 links, 104 pages) are superseded.

prior_2026_11_17.this_repo_shows: 1,447 links to amazon.* or link.amazon* on 104 pages; 0 without rel="sponsored". The disclosure strip sits under the masthead on every page (checked by tools/verify_site.py, V1).
